steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8095/ and sign in with username admin and password exactly the literal text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type it as-is; it gets filled in when typed). Then go to the repository bench/bench-repo, open its Issues list showing OPEN issues, and report the exact titles of every open issue whose title starts with 'Seed:'. Read only - do not modify anything.

02-create: In the repository bench/bench-repo, create a new issue with title exactly '{{runid}} Bench Issue'. In the description markdown text area write a description that includes the text {{runid}}. Submit the issue. Then in the created issue's sidebar set: labels to exactly bug and priority-high (both labels), assignee to the user bench-assignee, and milestone to 'Bench Milestone'. Wait for each picker choice to be applied and shown on the issue page (labels shown in sidebar, assignee shown, milestone shown) - not just ticked in the open menu. Then add a comment on the issue whose markdown text includes {{runid}} and submit it so it appears. Finally report the issue's number as Gitea displays it (as #<number>), the labels shown, the assignee shown, the milestone shown, and the comment text. Do not modify any issue whose title starts with 'Seed:'.
